---
title: "Grading"
---

## Evaluation Breakdown

| Component | Marks |
|-----------|------:|
| Theory (3 modules × 23) | 69 |
| Laboratory (3 labs × 7) | 21 |
| Attendance | 10 |
| **Total** | **100** |

### Theory (69 marks)

- Module 1: 23 marks
- Module 2: 23 marks
- Module 3: 23 marks

Each module test evaluates conceptual understanding and problem-solving aligned with its corresponding module.

### Laboratory (21 marks)

Three lab evaluations at 7 marks each. Assessment includes: lab performance, code quality, viva/demo, submissions, and written quizzes.

### Attendance (10 marks)

| Absences | Marks |
|----------|------:|
| ≤ 4 | 10 |
| 5 | 9 |
| 6 | 8 |
| 7 | 7 |
| 8 | 6 |
| 9 | 3 |
| 10 | 2 |
| > 10 | 0 |

Students bear responsibility for ensuring their attendance is recorded via the biometric system. Unrecorded attendance counts as an absence regardless of physical presence.

## Policies

**Leave requests:** There is no leave request system. Any missed class registers as an absence. Students need not notify the instructor or submit medical documentation for individual absences.

**Exceptional circumstances:** Students facing emergencies requiring 4+ consecutive absences may discuss special consideration with the instructor directly.
